data.name: Muhammadi
data.gender_notes: Muhammadi is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A devoted follower of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name Muhammadi carries the meaning “Lover of Muhammad” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muhammadi usually hope their child will grow to embody lover of muhammad and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Muhammadi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lover of Muhammad.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muhammadi total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
